segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רד
הַמָּעוֹת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִין לְתַלְמִיד חָכָם הוּא בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה מַמָּשׁ, וְאֵין עֲבֵרָה יְכוֹלָה לְכַבּוֹת זֶה הַמָּעוֹת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִין לְתַלְמִיד־חָכָם, כִּי אֵין עֲבֵרָה מְכַבָּה תּוֹרָה, וְזֶה מָעוֹת רָאשֵׁי־תֵּבוֹת: "וְאֵין "עֲבֵרָה "מְכַבָּה "תּוֹרָה (סוֹטָה כ"א):
segments.en: The corruption of faith — G-d forbid — is the aspect of idolatry. And then there is burning wrath in the world. And through the travels of the children of Israel — through which this blemish is atoned as above — the burning wrath is sweetened. And compassion is drawn into the world. And the primary compassion is in the aspect of: "and may El Shaddai give you compassion" [Genesis 43:14] — to you specifically. That He surrender the compassion into our hands — as we understand (see the main text).
